# Go 792417b fixture

`fastclaw-go.db` is generated by the locked FastClaw Go implementation at
`792417b86b5c12af1b99364865217a74f4d52f38`. It contains synthetic identities,
credentials, a channel configuration, API-key ACL, and one tool-using session.
No production credential or user data is present.

To regenerate it, archive the locked Go commit into a temporary directory, copy
`generator/main.go` into `<archive>/cmd/fixturegen/main.go`, and run:

```console
go run ./cmd/fixturegen /path/to/fastclaw-go.db /path/to/manifest.json
```

The bcrypt salt and SQLite page layout are intentionally nondeterministic.
Validation compares schema and logical row content rather than raw database bytes.
